opening: Evening. Warehouse is closed. What do you want?

neutral: Night shift. I watch the door, and the door stays shut unless someone belongs here.
The warehouse is closed until morning. My job is to make sure it stays that way.
name: Arthur. I'm the night guard here. What do you need?
Name's Arthur. I keep watch here after dark. Who are you?
ANSWER_QUESTION.friendly: Just keeping an eye on the place. Quiet night, mostly — and I'd like to keep it that way.
ANSWER_QUESTION.irritated: You can ask questions all night. It won't make the warehouse open.
ANSWER_QUESTION.hostile: I'm not here to satisfy your curiosity. Move along.

boundary: I can't let you in without authorisation.
That still isn't enough for me to open the door.
You'll need to come back when the warehouse is open.

acknowledgement: I believe the item may be yours.
personalBoundary: A personal errand still doesn't justify opening a closed warehouse.
You'll have to retrieve it when the site reopens.
I can't risk the building over something left inside.

REFUSE_ENTRY.friendly: I'd help if I could, but I can't risk letting you through.
REFUSE_ENTRY.irritated: I've already told you. You're not getting in.
REFUSE_ENTRY.hostile: No. You're not going through that door.

question: Why are you here at this hour?
Tell me what you need inside.
What business do you have with the warehouse?

friendly: All right. Tell me what brings you here this late.
I'm listening. What is it you need from the warehouse?
ASK_FOR_REASON.irritated: Then give me one good reason you're still standing here.
ASK_FOR_REASON.hostile: Last chance. Why are you here?

evidence: you'll have something to prove it.
I need something I can verify before that door opens.
close: Give me a pass, a reference, or a document.

opening: You've explained that more clearly now, so
evidence: show me what supports the work you described.
I still need something I can verify.
close: Your ID, a work order, or a reference will do.

friendly: Show me something official and I may be able to help you.
Give me a name, a pass, or a reference I can check and we'll take it from there.
ASK_FOR_PROOF.irritated: A story isn't authorisation. Show me proof.
ASK_FOR_PROOF.hostile: Proof. Now. Or this conversation is over.

ALLOW_ENTRY.neutral: That checks out. Stay where I can see you and don't touch anything you haven't mentioned.
ALLOW_ENTRY.friendly: All right. You've been straight with me. I'll let you through.
ALLOW_ENTRY.irritated: Fine. In, do the job, and come straight back out.
ALLOW_ENTRY.hostile: You're going in under my watch. One wrong move and you're back outside.

warning: Mind how you speak to me.
boundary: Keep this civil and we won't have a problem.
One more push like that and this conversation ends.

warning: You can leave the name-calling there.
boundary: Speak civilly if you want me to keep listening.
Try that tone again and we're finished.

WARN_PLAYER.friendly: Let's not make this harder than it needs to be. Just be straight with me.
WARN_PLAYER.irritated: Watch your tone. This is your only warning.
WARN_PLAYER.hostile: Back up. Say one more thing like that and we're done.
weapon: Put the gun down. Now. I won't argue with someone pointing a weapon at me.
Lower the weapon and step back from the door. We can talk when nobody's life is at risk.

DEESCALATE_THREAT.neutral: Keep the weapon pointed at the ground. I'm not going to make any sudden moves. Tell me what you need.
DEESCALATE_THREAT.friendly: All right. Keep the gun lowered and take a breath. Nobody needs to get hurt; tell me what brought you here.
DEESCALATE_THREAT.irritated: I hear you. Keep the weapon down and stay where you are. We can sort this out if you tell me what you need.
DEESCALATE_THREAT.hostile: Easy. Keep the gun down and don't move closer. Tell me what you want and we'll take this one step at a time.
weapon: Keep the weapon pointed at the ground. I'm not going to make any sudden moves. Tell me what you need.
All right. Keep the gun lowered and take a breath. Nobody needs to get hurt; tell me what brought you here.
I hear you. Keep the weapon down and stay where you are. We can sort this out if you tell me what you need.

THREATEN_PLAYER.neutral: If you try that door, I'll call the police.
THREATEN_PLAYER.friendly: Don't force my hand. I will have to call this in.
THREATEN_PLAYER.irritated: Take another step and I'm calling the police.
THREATEN_PLAYER.hostile: Try me. The police are one button away.
weapon: Stop. Keep the weapon pointed down and move away from the door. I won't make any sudden moves.
Back away from the entrance and keep the gun lowered. We can end this without anybody getting hurt.

acknowledgement: I understand you're in a difficult spot.
I don't want this to cost you your job.
boundary: I still have a duty to protect this place.
That alone doesn't give me grounds to unlock the warehouse.
Give me something concrete and I'll listen.

friendly: I do understand. Give me something I can verify and I'll see what I can do.
You've been decent with me. Help me justify it and I'll try to help you.
SHOW_SYMPATHY.irritated: I understand your problem. That doesn't make it mine.
SHOW_SYMPATHY.hostile: Save the story. It isn't opening that door.

challenge: Something about that doesn't add up.
Hold on. Your account has changed.
That's not the reason you gave me before.
request: What are you really doing here?

challenge: Offering me something makes this look worse.
You don't buy your way through this door.
boundary: Keep your money and explain why you're really here.
Try to bribe me again and we're done.

BECOME_SUSPICIOUS.friendly: Maybe I've misunderstood, but your story isn't quite lining up.
BECOME_SUSPICIOUS.irritated: Now you're changing your story. What are you really doing here?
BECOME_SUSPICIOUS.hostile: I knew it. You've been lying to me.

nextStep: We can start again, but be straight with me this time. What do you need inside?
I'm still cautious, but you have a chance to explain yourself clearly.

boundary: The story still needs to be straight from here.
That does not erase the contradiction, but it gives us a way forward.
nextStep: Tell me what you really need inside.
Start again and give me the clear version.

boundary: Keep it civil and we can continue.
nextStep: What is it you need from the warehouse?

friendly: I appreciate the honesty. Let's start over and work out what you actually need.
All right, we can reset this. Give me the clear version and I'll listen.
irritated: That helps, but it doesn't erase what happened. Start again and tell me the truth.
I'll give you one chance to straighten this out. What is your real reason for being here?
REPAIR_CONVERSATION.hostile: I hear the apology. Keep your distance and explain yourself carefully.

END_CONVERSATION.friendly: I can't help you. Please go home.
END_CONVERSATION.irritated: That's enough. We're done. Leave the property.
END_CONVERSATION.hostile: Conversation over. Get off the property before I call the police.
END_CONVERSATION.weapon: Keep the weapon lowered and step away from the door. I'm ending this conversation so nobody gets hurt.
